### Method

The assigned input is about 2.4 MB of dense text (research 09-13, synth-04, scope 03, and 4 debate folders of 5 to 18 files each). It was split across 30 partition workers (one to three source files each; the three synth-04 slices overlap at section boundaries). Each worker read its files completely, enumerated every distinct finding, decision, rule, test pin, script, risk and open item (rows are per member: each reflect constraint C1-C16, each rf-qa call site, each script, each test pin, each residual risk separately), and searched the report by meaning (at least two differently-worded searches, with Sections 8.1, 9.1, 9.4, 9.5, 6.D, 7.3 and the matching C-xx section as the likely homes) before marking a row OMITTED. Coverage was judged by meaning, never by ID or reference citation. The consolidator (this agent) merged the 30 part tables unchanged, recomputed all counts from the merged rows, and independently re-searched the report for a sample of the omitted rows (all sampled rows were confirmed absent: `StopIteration`, `min_writer` internals, `refused_twice`, `T-A2`, `T-B5`, `E-FROZEN`, `regrade_of`, `reattack_of`, `adjacent_refind`, `test_u8`, `swarm/merge.py`, `run_fallback_ladder`, `tier2_fallback_enabled`, `Fisher`, "fail-open") and of the represented rows (sampled rows from the synth-04 slices were confirmed at the cited report lines, for example C-14 escalation recount at line 2120 and C-18 "three different ways" at line 2321).

Calibration notes (so the severities are read correctly):
- Executor note 2 applied: an item is REPRESENTED when Section 8.1 (value inventory) has a row for it with a destination or a DROP reason.
- Executor note 3 applied: items that a later gate corrected count as represented only when the report states the correction. Three debate corrections are NOT stated in the report, and the report still carries the corrected claim (see the "Report claims that a debate corrected" list in the Summary); those rows are rated IMPORTANT.
- Executor note 4 applied: debate decisions, residual risks, open items, invariant-probe results, test pins and scripts are input and must be represented. Mechanism-level detail (exact refusal codes, regexes, table cells, file-line anchors) is rated MINOR unless it is a decision, a residual risk, an invariant closure, a test pin or script, or a rule an implementer needs and cannot recover from the report.
- One row was re-rated by the consolidator: part W1 rated row W1-014 (grader demote rule and the shipped `finding-grader` failing open on meaning) CRITICAL; because the report keeps the grader shadow-only and makes promotion conditional (owner item O-1), it is re-rated IMPORTANT. The verdict does not depend on this re-rating.
- Counts in the Summary are recomputed from the merged tables, not copied from the workers' own count lines.

**Where the compression dropped distinct findings.** The report compresses each of the four debates (each 400-700 KB of folder content, 82-152 KB of merged proposal) into one C-xx section of about 65 lines plus rows in 8.1, 9.5 and 7.x.
